title: Protect container settlement lifecycle and explicit loading source integrity
description: Stage3 core finance closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Secure every container settlement list/detail/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete/expense-evidence route with current enabled identity, existing container-settlement menu and current customer scope before counts, numbers, source evidence or writes. Optional LoadingListId must resolve exact existing eligible loading list and authoritative customer/participant scope using ERP364 rules, with settlement CustomerId a real enabled participant/customer. Mixed-customer evidence requires access to every included customer. Keep null legacy source semantics and fail closed for unknown ownership; do not infer source from text or grant permissions.

Validate positive settlement TotalAmount and nonnegative freight/other costs using existing storage precision; settlement has no currency field, so preserve explicit raw amount semantics without invented conversion or cross-currency aggregation or formula imposing total=sum(costs). Serialize source loading row before settlement row for edit/state/delete and source cancel, recheck persisted/request scope and status under locks. Nondeleted noncancelled linked settlement blocks loading cancellation until explicit settlement cancel releases it. Preserve history and denied-write audit, no stock/funds/accounting effects. Actual controller SQL invalid/foreign/mixed/revoked/disabled, edit rollback and two-connection edit vs submit, approve vs cancel and loading cancel vs linked settlement creation/approval. Run relevant unit and safe Release verification; record real browser evidence or accurate blocker.

LoadingListId can reference a foreign or cancelled loading list and source cancellation can invalidate a live settlement.
